CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayDeleteAt

Removes the element at the given position. Every element after it moves down one position, so the array becomes one element shorter.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayDeleteAt(array, position)

Parameters

array
The array to change.
position
Position of the element to delete, from 1 to ArrayLen(array).

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

A position outside the array throws an Expression exception ("Array index out of range").

When you delete several elements in a loop, loop from the end of the array toward the start, so the positions you have not visited yet do not shift underneath you.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Browsers = ListToArray("Netscape 4.7,Mosaic,Internet Explorer 5,Lynx")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #ArrayToList(Browsers, ", ")#</P>
<!--- Mosaic has retired --->
<CFSET Temp = ArrayDeleteAt(Browsers, 2)>
<P>After ArrayDeleteAt(Browsers, 2): #ArrayToList(Browsers, ", ")#</P>
<P>Element 2 is now <B>#Browsers[2]#</B>.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayInsertAt, ArrayClear, ArrayLen, ListDeleteAt
